title: Desert Storm - The Air War, Day 1 - Animated
summary: An animated account of Day 1 of the Desert Storm air war on 17 January 1991, covering the 2,775 sorties flown against Iraqi strategic targets in the first 24 hours.
why: Recommended as a deeply researched, visual series that shows how overwhelming the coalition air campaign was.

quote.text: I highly recommend watching this series about it, no one has dug into history like the Operations Room channel
